gloss: to be thirsty, to be parched; to thirst for

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {渇|かわ}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be thirsty, to be parched
definitions.explanation: To feel thirst. Used with 喉 (throat) in the pattern 喉が渇く. Written with 渇 to distinguish from 乾く (to dry physically).
To strongly desire or crave something, used figuratively.

examples.english: On hot days, you get thirsty easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{渇|かわ}いた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I was thirsty, so I bought water from a vending machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{渇|かわ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{渇|かわ}いた⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Young people thirsting for knowledge gathered at the library.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{渇|かわ}く.

ASPECT (ている):
{渇|かわ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a current state of being thirsty.

WRITING:
{渇|かわ}く and ⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ are both read かわく but have different meanings. {渇|かわ}く means "to be thirsty" or "to crave," while ⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ means "to dry" or "to become dry." In practice, ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{渇|かわ}く and ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ are both used for thirst, but {渇|かわ}く emphasizes the craving while ⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ emphasizes the physical dryness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{渇|かわ}く (to be thirsty)
- ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{渇|かわ}く (to crave affection)
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{渇|かわ}く (to thirst for knowledge)
